name: Shinda Hazu no Kanojo ~Kanojo de Nai "Nanika" ni Okasarete~
original_name: 死んだはずの彼女～彼女でない“何か”に犯されて～
source:
Shinya Miura, who works in the city, lost his beloved girlfriend, Risa, in an accident two years ago.

One summer day, when Shinya returns home from a Bon vacation,
his friends and Risa's parents, have the illusion that Risa is alive.
As if her death had never happened.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/dlaf/=/link/work/aid/vndb/id/RJ377997.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
在城里工作的三浦慎也，在两年前的一场事故中失去了心爱的女友丽莎。

一个夏日，当Shinya结束盂兰盆节假期回到家时，
他的朋友和丽莎的父母都幻想着丽莎还活着。
就好像她的死从未发生过一样。

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/dlaf/=/link/work/aid/vndb/id/RJ377997.html]DLsite[/url]]
